title.narrative: Indonesia: Strengthening National Tuberculosis Response Program

description.narrative: The development objective of the Strengthening National Tuberculosis (TB) Response Program (NTP) for Indonesia is to improve coverage, quality, and efficiency of tuberculosis services in Indonesia. Indonesia's NTP focuses on expanding case finding, retaining treated cases, and strengthening interventions for drug-resistant cases, with improved information systems to reduce underreporting and to achieve its ambitious goal of 90 percent reduction in new TB cases by 2030. The document defines three technical strategies that address the TB program intervention areas (prevention, diagnostics, and treatment) and is supported by three strategies meant to respond to contextual issues, that is, functional strategies. The technical strategies are as follows: (a) increasing access to high-quality and patient-centered TB diagnosis and treatment services; (b) optimizing promotion and prevention efforts and providing TB prevention therapy and infection control; and (c) increasing communities, partners, and multi-sectoral participation in TB elimination efforts.
To improve coverage, quality and efficiency of tuberculosis services in Indonesia

condition.narrative: In implementing the Program, the Borrower, through MOH, shall act through its various internal working units and bodies, each ofwhich shall comprise competent, experienced and qualified staff, in sufficient numbers and under terms of reference acceptable tothe Bank. To this end, the Borrower shall, through the MOH:(a) by no later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, or suchlater date as may be agreed between the Bank and the Borrower in writing, establish and thereafter maintain, at all times duringthe implementation of the Program, the Program Secretariat under the Secretary General within the MOH, which shall be responsiblefor coordinating the implementation of the Program among all the implementing units.(b) by no later than sixty (60) days afterthe Effective Date, or such later date as may be agreed between the Bank and the Borrower in writing, establish and thereaftermaintain, at all times during the implementation of the Program, the Steering Committee at the Secretary General level within theMOH, which shall be responsible for providing overall policy guidance and oversight to the Program Secretariat and otherimplementing units within the MOH on Program implementation. (Section I.A.1 of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement)

No later than two (2) months after the Effective Date, or such later date as may be agreed between the Bank and the Borrower, theBorrower shall appoint BPKP to act as an independent verification agent to undertake the DLR verification process referred to inparagraph 2 below in respect of all DLRs for the Program in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Bank. TheBorrower shall ensure that BPKP shall: (a) verify the data and other evidence supporting the achievement(s) of one or more DLRsunder Categories (1) through (7) as set forth in the table in Section IV.A.2 of Schedule 2 of the Loan Agreement, and recommendcorresponding payments to be made, as applicable, in accordance with the Verification Protocol agreed with the Bank; and (b) submitto the Bank the corresponding verification reports in a timely manner and in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank. (SectionI.B.1&2 of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement)

Not later than twenty-four (24) months after the Effective Date or such other date as may be agreed between the Borrower and theBank, the Borrower shall, in conjunction with the Bank, carry out a mid-term review of the Program (“Mid-term Review”), coveringthe progress achieved in the implementation of the Program. To this end, the Borrower shall prepare and furnish to the Bank notless than three (3) months prior to the beginning of the Mid-term Review, a report integrating the results of the Program'smonitoring and evaluation activities on the progress achieved in the carrying out of the Program during the period preceding thedate of such report, and setting out the measures recommended to ensure the efficient carrying out of the Program and theachievement of the objective of the Program during the period following such date. Following the Mid-term Review, the Borrowershall act promptly and diligently in order to take, or cause to be taken, any corrective action deemed necessary by the Bank toremedy any shortcoming noted in the carrying out of the Program in furtherance of the objective of the Program. (Section III.C ofSchedule 2 to the Loan Agreement)

The Borrower declares its commitment to the objectives of the Program. To this end, the Borrower, through the MOH, shall carry outthe Program in accordance with the provisions of Article V of the General Conditions and Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. (Section3.01 of the Loan Agreement)
